reading: All three kernels already have exhaustive supports: two observation constructors with half masses, one state and one policy with unit masses. Repair adds distinctness and zero-off-support proofs, no mass changes. ProbabilityKernel now demands both support laws. factorFixture still proves half times one times one equals half. Fixture ports and FactorReference adapter fields preserve this factorisation; no theorem premise changes.
exit-convention: Positive checks receipt, fixture and Lean. Negative exits 0 if GenerativeModelNegative.lean #guard_msgs elaborates rejecting mis-wired state carrier; 2 otherwise. Its negative branch does not require receipt-ok; positive is run independently.
